items.summary: The visit featured discussions on energy security, advanced manufacturing, digital infrastructure and opportunities for commercial collaboration between Indian and American companies.

items.title: Gold Swings as Traders Assess Fed Rate Path Amid Mideast Worries
items.summary: Gold fluctuated as traders assessed the outlook for the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path on the back of potential renewed hositilities in the Middle East.

items.title: Treasuries Slide After Middle East Strife Report Spurs Oil Gains
items.summary: Treasuries fell after reports suggesting the Middle East war is heating up lifted oil prices.

items.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq leads Wall Street higher as SpaceX, Super Micro lift AI sentiment
items.summary: US stocks ended higher on Wednesday as SpaceX and Super Micro Computer boosted sentiment around artificial intelligence stocks. The Nasdaq led gains, while strong semiconductor stocks added support. However, weakness in Netflix, AT&T and other communications shares limited the broader advance as investors awaited more major technology earnings.

items.title: Meta raises AI spending forecast to $145 billion, plans new share issue; Q3 revenue beats estimates
items.summary: Meta raised its 2026 capital expenditure forecast to $135 billion-$145 billion to accelerate AI expansion and announced plans for non-voting shares, while reporting stronger revenue amid mounting legal challenges and intensifying competition.

items.title: RBI flags widening inflation risks, puts rate cuts on ice
items.summary: RBI's Monetary Policy Committee raised the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points to address rising inflation concerns. Governor Sanjay Malhotra indicated a generalisation of inflation, with many commodities exceeding 4% inflation. Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta highlighted the influence of external supply-side shocks on inflation projections. External members expressed concerns about the implications of an aggressive…

items.title: Critical tech list under review to push self-reliance
items.summary: India's Niti Aayog is preparing a list of critical technologies for enhancing self-reliance and investment. This initiative aims to protect against disruptions due to limited access to essential technologies. Potential technologies include 6G, defence equipment, and electric vehicle powertrains. The government seeks to encourage innovation through the Anusandhan National Research Foundation and other funds. A…

items.title: Core output grows at series high of 7.9% in Sept
items.summary: India's core sector output growth for September recorded a remarkable 7.9%, driven largely by expansion in coal and electricity. Notably, refinery products and iron ore also contributed to this growth, supported by a favorable base effect. Coal production saw a sharp rebound with a growth rate of 10.7% following previous negative trends. Electricity generation growth declined slightly, impacted by heatwave…

items.title: Piyush Goyal to explore trade, investment avenues in Germany & Netherlands
items.summary: Commerce and industry minister Piyush Goyal is set to visit Germany and the Netherlands for trade engagements. He will participate in the Berlin Global Dialogue and meet various government officials in Germany. The focus will be on technological cooperation, clean technology, and the India-EU FTA negotiations. In the Netherlands, Goyal will hold ministerial meetings to explore expanded trade channels and green…

items.title: BlackRock expands AI push with new robotics ETF as investor enthusiasm cools
items.summary: BlackRock has launched a new robotics focused ETF as investors become more selective about AI investments. The fund targets companies using intelligent machines across industries such as manufacturing and transportation, adding to a rapidly expanding market of ETFs built around different parts of the AI theme.

items.title: Ex-Brevan Howard Trader Sued by Quant Who Joined His New Fund
items.summary: Ex-Brevan Howard Asset Management portfolio manager Robert Sicari was accused of withholding millions of dollars in promised trading profits from a former colleague who joined his new fund.

items.title: Import window for duty-free raw sugar extended till Dec 31
items.summary: The government has extended the deadline for duty-free imports of 10 lakh tonnes of raw sugar to December 31, as domestic imports have lagged at just 3 lakh tonnes due to price control measures. This decision aims to mitigate supply constraints following record high sugar prices linked to reduced domestic production and exports.

items.title: Tesla-SpaceX merger: Only a matter of when, not if — but how much should Tesla shareholders be paid?
items.summary: Wall Street increasingly expects a Tesla-SpaceX merger, but key terms remain unsettled. Analysts say Tesla shareholders may seek a 20% to 35% premium, while the exchange ratio and Musk’s potential control of up to 58% of voting rights could raise valuation and governance concerns.

items.title: US court orders Meta to pay $25 bn for misleading users on data privacy
items.summary: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion after a jury found 43 million violations of state consumer protection laws linked to the Cambridge Analytica data privacy scandal.

items.title: Ambani family hosts Marco Rubio and Sergio Gor at Jamnagar refinery; Reliance, US explore energy partnership
items.summary: Reliance Industries Chairman Mukesh Ambani and Executive Director Anant Ambani hosted US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Ambassador Sergio Gor in Jamnagar. Here's what they discussed during the visit.

items.title: US Treasury yields slip as AI concerns boost safe haven demand ahead of 20 year auction
items.summary: US Treasury yields slipped as investors weighed the impact of higher borrowing costs on AI stocks, with the 10 year yield heading for a second straight daily decline. The move came ahead of a $13 billion 20 year Treasury auction, while markets continued to price in a muted chance of a Fed rate hike.

items.title: Sundaram MF enters SIF space; Choice MF launches first active equity fund
items.summary: Sundaram MF enters the SIF segment, Choice MF launches its first active equity scheme, while Edelweiss Alternative Asset Advisors sets a ₹1,585-1,665 price band for its ₹1,200 crore IPO

items.title: Persistent Systems launches Rs 4,265-cr QIP; floor price set at Rs 5,550/share
items.summary: Persistent Systems has opened a qualified institutional placement to raise up to USD 450 million, or about Rs 4,265 crore. The IT company has set the QIP floor price at Rs 5,550 per share and may offer investors a discount of up to 5% under the approved pricing terms.

items.title: $30 million! Who is Zach Yadegari? Meet teenage founder - Know how he turned AI calorie tracking into a massive business
items.summary: American entrepreneur Zach Yadegari co-founded Cal AI, a calorie-tracking app that reportedly generated more than $30 million in annual revenue before its acquisition by MyFitnessPal. Now, the 19-year-old founder is building Persona, an AI assistant startup that has raised $10 million.

items.title: Google rolls out Gemini Personal Intelligence to Android Auto, brings AI to Apple CarPlay
items.summary: The updates extend Google’s AI assistant across in-car platforms, with optional access to personal data and navigation-based features for drivers.

items.title: FSSAI issues notices to Zydus Wellness, Nestle India
items.summary: FSSAI said it has issued notices to Nestle India for “misleading claims and non-compliant promotions” involving two food products ‘Lactogen Pro 1 Powder’ and ‘Nan Excella Pro Stage 1’

items.title: IHCL to have 700 hotels within FY27, says MD & CEO Puneet Chhatwal
items.summary: Indian Hotels Company expects to reach 700 hotels in FY27, ahead of its 2030 target, and has raised its FY27 revenue growth guidance to 15-17% from 12-14%

items.title: India Cements Capital receives open offer letter at ₹12 per share
items.summary: The open offer will open on October 28 and close on November 11, 2026

items.title: Flipkart's Big Billion Days draws 9 in 10 shoppers as orders rise 20-22%
items.summary: Flipkart's 11-day festive sale saw orders, units and buyers rise 20-22% year-on-year, with nearly half of buyers from Gen Z and about 60% from Tier 2-plus cities

items.title: El Niño may reach unprecedented strength, raising global weather risks: WMO
items.summary: Pacific Ocean temperatures could rise 3.8°C above average during November-January, increasing risks of drought, floods and extreme heat

items.title: Wendt’s consolidated net profit doubles in Q2 FY27
items.summary: The increase in profit was mainly due to higher volume and cost optimisation initiatives focused on reducing manufacturing expenses despite input cost increase

items.summary: The new unit is expected to reduce machine delivery lead times, the company said in a regulatory filing
